module: Data module for genericGauges: computes the displayed power, the power and torque, the remaining range and a consumption graph for electric motors.
notes: The motors are the devices of type "electricMotor"; the batteries are their registered energy storages. Range = stored energy * 0.0278 / average consumption per 100 km.
The consumption is smoothed and only changes if the vehicle is moving (> 0.5 m/s). updateGaugeData reads electrics.values.wheelspeed without a default.
setupGaugeData adds the batteries without clearing the previous list (a second call duplicates them).

updateGFX.desc: Does nothing (the update is done by updateGaugeData).

setupGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges with the properties requested in displayData.customModules: powerDisplay (electricPowerDisplay: average throttle minus regeneration), currentPower (currentPower and averagePower in hp, currentTorque in N·m), remainingRange, consumptionGraph (averageConsumption, sent every 5 s, otherwise nil).

properties.desc: Set of requested properties (key = name, value = true).

updateGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges before each send: fills moduleData with the requested values.

moduleData.desc: Module data table, then sent to the HTML page.

dt.desc: Time elapsed since the last send (s).
